name: Seed Starter České spořitelny
decision_note: Corporate VC arm of Česká spořitelna (Erste Group) investing pre-seed/seed in fintech-relevant startups; co-invested in Repsense (Dec 2025), Pointee (Apr 2026) and Definic (Jun 2026).

evidence.quote: Since 2020 we have been investing in technologies that help banking thrive or bring innovation to our clients.
Investiční kolo vedl český fond J&T Ventures, ke kterému se připojil Seed Starter patřící pod Českou spořitelnu a Slovak Investment Holding.
Investici vedl český fond Tensor Ventures, ke kterému se přidal Seed Starter České i Slovenské spořitelny.
Investiční kolo vedl český deeptech fond Tensor Ventures, přidaly se Seed Starter České spořitelny a stávající litevští investoři BSV Ventures a Coinvest Capital.
Největší tuzemská banka vyčlenila pro podobné účely 200 milionů korun, na konci roku chce mít podepsaných pět investic, které ukrojí zhruba polovinu tohoto budgetu.

analyst_notes: Corporate VC programme of Česká spořitelna, a.s. (Erste Group) investing through ČS Seed Starter, a.s. (same registered address as the bank; the 1996 company was repurposed for the programme launched in 2020). Stage and ticket are labels from the investor's strategy block ('Pre-seed & Seed' investment rounds, '200k – 1M EUR' investment). Sector: stated focus is technologies that help banking or bring innovation to the bank's clients (mapped to fintech; deals also include AI governance, vendor intelligence and information-risk analytics with a banking use case). Geography derived from cited deals (CZ, SK, LT); the site mentions the Czech Republic. Capital not disclosed: CzechCrunch (2023-11-27) reported CZK 180m invested in eight Czech startups in the first three years, which is cumulative deployment (and older than the window), not a fund size. Round amounts are whole-round sizes from the same articles (Definic EUR 2.5m seed, Pointee USD 1.4m seed, Repsense EUR 1.1m); Seed Starter's shares are undisclosed. Pointee round was joint with the separate Slovak programme Seed Starter Slovenskej sporiteľne (out of scope for this record). [revision 2026-10-25 re-audit: capital changed from not_disclosed to CZK 200m, basis balance_sheet: E15 (2021-11-19, e7) reports that Česká spořitelna set aside CZK 200m of its own money for the Seed Starter programme (no separate fund vehicle raised from LPs, so neither latest_fund_size nor a target); it is the latest public budget figure - the CZK 180m 'invested' (CzechCrunch 2023-11-27) is deployment, not capital. Activity (Definic seed 2026-06-12), scope (Pointee, CZ), corporate type and ticket (EUR 200k-1m, stated per company) unchanged.]
